authorities_relied_on.name: D15 parent adjudication and C11 architecture selection
PRE553 runtime path and interface law

semantic_claims: C11 can be concretized at the logical-contract level without selecting a physical storage engine by assigning every D13 M01-M18 information class to explicit logical record owners and immutable references.
The minimum deep response grain is respondent-event/component occurrence whenever authoritative topology permits multiplicity; scalar collapse requires positive topology authority.

Routing/risk-set incidence, future-authorizable coordinate incidence, weight/design authority, source-universe relations, immutable authority snapshots, and deterministic replay identity are first-class carrier obligations rather than optional metadata.
Source-to-C11 admission is package-atomic at the semantic level: partial physical presence grants no C11 authority until M01-M18 closure and replay identity are sealed.
Current Postgres/facet/shared-V550 surfaces are migration evidence/validation oracles only and cannot be declared equivalent by schema, count, aggregate, or selected-query parity.
claims_explicitly_refused: No storage engine, database schema, file format, codec, compression, or index strategy selected.
No current populated source or current shared substrate certified C11-equivalent.
No source pooling, respondent linkage, overlap treatment, backfill, or semantic equivalence inferred from labels/harmonization/provenance.
No empirical-coordinate to generated-position or empirical-association to structural-truth promotion authorized.
No actor, V3, V2, persona, belief, psyche, or render semantics introduced.
No downstream M1-M6 object or interface changed.
No runtime implementation or executable test created.
exact_head_binding: Return envelope must report the exact mission-branch Git SHA after the final required output commit; it is intentionally not self-embedded because a Git commit cannot contain its own hash.
